scope: CPU retrieval microbenchmark with controlled actual queue execution receipts; not Gate or agent performance evidence
notes: Full reread uses the pre-index retrieve/remember algorithms and the unchanged receipt validator.
Cold measurements start with an empty derived cache and restored run IDs; fixture construction is excluded.
One-run invalidation appends a diagnostic event outside the measured retrieval.
Single-run layout tests worst-case changed-run revalidation; the cognitive shell normally has one receipt per run.
Latency and CPU are measured per call; count actual SQL statements as well as Store API calls.
Assert complete Experience equality on every measured retrieval and detect appended forged outcomes.
